name: Cable Reverse Crunch
steps: Lie face up with your feet toward a low pulley and the rope running between your legs.
Hold the rope ends above your chest and bend your knees.
Keep your hands still and curl your pelvis off the floor as you draw your knees toward your chest.
Roll your pelvis back down and extend your legs toward the pulley under control.
tips: Keep a slight bend in your knees and stop extending your legs before your lower back arches.
Curl your pelvis with your abs instead of swinging your legs using momentum.
